rules.title: Programme rules
rules.description: Know the rules before joining the programme.

benefits.title: Benefits & income
benefits.description: What you get from the referral programme.

rulesItems: Only one referral application can be submitted per account.
Fake, duplicate or self-referrals are not accepted.
Referral income only activates once your application is approved.
When the conditions are met, referral income is added straight to your wallet.
Breaking the rules may result in removal from the programme.
eligibilityItems: You must have an active and verified RizqifyBD customer account.
Your account must not be banned or deleted.
You must accept the programme's terms and conditions.
You must promote the platform honestly and transparently.
Eligibility is maintained with regular active referrals.
benefitsItems: Attractive income for every successful referral.
Income straight to your wallet — easy to withdraw.
Full tracking and reports from your dashboard.
A fully secure, transparent and verified process.
